get_merge_request_note.description: Get a specific note for a merge request. Use this to fetch one known merge request note by note identifier; use `get_merge_request_notes` for a collection and `mr_discussions` for threaded context. It is read-only and returns the note object or an error for an invalid identifier, missing note, or insufficient permission.

merge_request_iid.description: The IID of a merge request

note_id.description: The ID of a thread note

project_id.description: Project ID or complete URL-encoded path to project
